section_title: Procedure for Curriculum Development Review and Validation

section_title: Academic Council and Board Approval Process
original_text: The Academic Council deliberates the proposed new or revised curriculum for endorsement to the LNU Board of Regents. The LNU Board of Regents approves the proposed new or revised curriculum. The Curriculum Officer submits the approved curriculum to CHED, disseminates it after CHED approval, and the UCC Chair endorses implementation of the LNU-BOR approved and CHED compliant curriculum.
revised_text: 1. The Academic Council shall deliberate the proposed curriculum and endorse the documented recommendation to the LNU Board of Regents. 2. The Curriculum Officer shall submit the approved curriculum to CHED for the applicable documentation and retain the submission record. 4. After CHED approval or required confirmation, the Curriculum Officer shall disseminate the curriculum to the VPAS, Deans, Program Chair, and Registrar. 5. The UCC Chair shall endorse implementation only after LNU-BOR approval and required CHED compliance are confirmed.
reviewer_summary: The revision retains Academic Council review, BOR decision, CHED documentation, dissemination, and implementation endorsement while clarifying approval prerequisites and records.
